Subject: Q3 revenue integrity: upsell readiness checkpoint & CS handoff

Team —

Quick one ahead of next week’s commit window. Horizons Health (Amanda/Jeff) are at the final procurement stage for a 150-seat seat-add + dedicated support upsell (deal HZN-2742). Finance and leadership have asked for a clean commit slate by EOD Tuesday (6/16).

Ask: please update the attached commit tracker with best-estimate ARR and Probability by COB Monday, call out any open CS risks, and confirm the recommended commit % (we prefer conservative, supportable numbers). Specifically:
- Sales (Marcus/Connor): confirm list price ARR, expected signature date, and any open commercial items.
- CS (Monica/Grace): health summary, technical blockers, onboarding load, and whether we should classify as 100/75/50/25/0% commit.

I’ll consolidate and send to Finance for the pre-commit review on 6/17. If there are any procurement/legal hold-ups, flag here and loop Legal.

Attachments: commit_tracker_Q3_v2.xlsx (fill columns AB:AE), hzn_health_cs-risk-matrix.pdf (CS: please review).

Thanks —
Lauren
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 revenue integrity: upsell readiness checkpoint & CS handoff

Lauren / team —

Attached updated tracker with CS inputs. Summary:
- Health: GOOD — usage up 32% month-over-month on core product, no major P0s.
- Technical risk: One outstanding data mapping for single-sign-on provisioning (estimated 2 weeks work from Horizons IT).
- Enablement load: require 1.5 FTE onboarding for two weeks post-signature (we've accounted for cost in playbook).
- Recommended commit: 75% (we're confident but want a small buffer for the SSO timeframe).

Notes in tracker cells: see column AD for risk notes and column AE for mitigation steps. I also attached a 1-page risk matrix (hzn_health_cs-risk-matrix.pdf).

On procurement: Amanda noted they may request a short implementation SLA addendum; Marcus, can you confirm if we can include the 30-day ramp clause without legal review?

—Monica
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

- List ARR: $420k annualized for the 150-seat upsell (includes priority support uplift).
- Requested signature: currently targeted 6/25 by Horizons procurement, but their legal team may push to 7/02 if SLA amendment negotiation runs long.
